name: fdr-portal
description: FDR Portal - Security Deposit/FDR Management System for AICTE

scripts.build: pnpm --filter=backend build && pnpm --filter=client build && pnpm --filter=shared build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter=backend lint && pnpm --filter=client lint && pnpm --filter=shared lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter=backend lint:fix && pnpm --filter=client lint:fix && pnpm --filter=shared lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter=backend typecheck && pnpm --filter=client typecheck && pnpm --filter=shared typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter=backend test && pnpm --filter=client test && pnpm --filter=shared test
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter=backend test:watch & pnpm --filter=client test:watch & pnpm --filter=shared test:watch
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter=backend clean && pnpm --filter=client clean && pnpm --filter=shared clean && rm -rf node_modules
